title: fix(lint)!: refuse a stored page sort naming an unknown field, on every page sort slot (#30093)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYvKbGaAgjBLQdkwPB
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRSN1GiP9UgXGt4JWsZMg3B)_
Fixes #30093

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — an unknown sort field on a page slot moves from silent or warning to error: `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and the `page` publish door refuse a page sort they accepted before.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 页面上所有存储的排序（元素 `dataSource.sort`、关联列表的 `sort` 与 `parentDataSource.sort`、各列表类区块自带的 `sort`、列表页 `interfaceConfig.sort`、应用页 `record.sort`）写了对象没有的字段时，`os validate` 和页面发布门一律报 `page-field-unknown` 错误，指到具体槽位路径，并给出最接近的字段名。
- **为什么改：** 列表门对未知排序字段每次读取都答 `400 INVALID_SORT`。之前只有两个槽位在命令行给警告，其余槽位没人检查，页面照样发布成功，第一次打开就坏。
- **风险与回滚：** 这是收窄：以前能保存的这类页面，下次保存会被 422 拒绝；已存的页面照常加载，不受影响。点状路径、`created_at` 这类系统列、本栈没有的对象、没有字段表的对象都不判。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts` 的 `checkPageSortDeclaration`（三问的顺序与跳过条件）；`packages/lint/src/validate-page-field-bindings.ts` 的 `isPageSortRef`（这里不再读页面排序，避免一处报两次）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` 末尾的 #30093 用例。
- **两分钟验证：** 运行 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts -t 30093`，预期 6 个全绿：5 个槽位各自被 422 `INVALID_METADATA` 拒绝、`page-field-unknown` 指到槽位路径、没有存下任何行；对照组用真实字段全部保存成功。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`validateSortableFields` asks every stored page sort slot three questions, in the list door's order** (`checkPageSortDeclaration`): existence (`page-field-unknown`, `error`), provenance (`page-field-unprovisioned`, `warning`, a registry-injected anchor on an ADR-0015 `external` object) and sortability (`sort-field-unsortable`, `error`, unchanged from #30084). The slots and their bindings are the ones #30084 already walks, each bound to the object its renderer reads: `dataSource.sort` → `dataSource.object`; a block's own `sort` → `dataSource.object ?? BLOCK_OBJECT_PROP` (`PAGE_BLOCK_SORT_OBJECT_PROP`); `parentDataSource.sort` → `parentDataSource.object`; `interfaceConfig.sort` → `interfaceConfig.source ?? page.object`; `record.sort` → `record.object`. Keys are read by `readSortKeys`, so the legacy string form is judged by its head, and the `-field` shorthand and comma-separated keys are each judged.
- **The grade is `error` on every slot.** The list door (`assertSortFieldsExist`) answers an unknown sort name `400 INVALID_SORT` on the first read and every read after it, which is the list view's `sort-field-unknown` grade. The id stays the page family's (`page-field-unknown`), so a page author reads the page rule.
- **Why this member.** `validateSortableFields` is the one reference-integrity member that declares `page` in `runtimeTypes` (#30084), so the page publish door (`PUT /api/v1/meta/page/NAME`; Studio, REST, MCP) now refuses the save `422 INVALID_METADATA` instead of storing a page that breaks on its first read. `validatePageFieldBindings` runs on the CLI only.
- **`validatePageFieldBindings` no longer reads a page sort** (`isPageSortRef` sets aside a related list's `sort` refs; `interfaceConfig.sort` is no longer collected), so each slot has exactly one reader and one finding. `relatedListFieldRefs` and `sortFieldRefs` keep their exported behaviour for out-of-repo callers and the react surface.
- **Skips, the `page-field-unknown` family's own:** a dotted relationship path (the door refuses it as its own verdict), a registry-injected system column (an author-declared field of a system name falls through to the projection, keeping #30084's verdict on it), an object the stack or the publish snapshot does not carry, and an object with no field map.

## Tests

- `validate-sortable-fields.test.ts`, new `describe` (#30093): every page slot refused as `page-field-unknown` at `error` at its slot path (rule + path + severity asserted for all nine), message and fix line pinned once; `validatePageFieldBindings` reports none of those slots while still reading a related list's columns (non-vacuity); each slot bound to its renderer's object; legacy string head, `-field` and comma keys; the skips; provenance on the external object at `warning` and silence on the local twin; an author-declared system-named field keeps `sort-field-unsortable`. The #30023 control no longer lists an unknown name as "not this rule's", and the one-line coverage pin now expects the two page ids beside the three sort ids.
- `validate-page-field-bindings.test.ts`: the related-list case drops its sort expectation; the #4340 legacy-string case moves to the sortable suite and is replaced by a pin that this walk reads no `interfaceConfig.sort` in either form while still reading the columns.
- `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` (#30093): five slots (element `dataSource.sort`, `parentDataSource.sort`, a related list's `sort`, `interfaceConfig.sort`, an app page's `record.sort`) each refused `422` / `INVALID_METADATA` with one `page-field-unknown` issue at `error` at the slot path, nothing stored; control: the same pages on a declared field save.

## Acceptance notes

- The two code notes on the page crossing (`packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts`, the `validateSortableFields` member note; `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, the `page` crossing note) said it judges a page sort "by the sortability projection alone". Corrected in review round 1 (comments only).
- A `kind: 'react'` page's sort props stay with `validate-react-page-props` (`sortFieldRefs`, the `skipped` grade). They are JSX props, not stored page sort slots, and are outside this card.

## Review round 1: what changed

Head `df135352` → `647a1c1f`, one commit, after the contract review (FAIL, comment 6649790600): one must-fix and one should-fix, both taken.

- **M1.** `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` §5 said a `record:related_list`'s `columns`/`sort`/`filter` resolve through the page-binding rule and are advisory. It now names `columns`/`filter` only, and a new paragraph says a page sort is the exception: every stored page sort slot naming a field the bound object lacks is a `page-field-unknown` **error**, and the page publish door refuses the save `422 INVALID_METADATA`, because the list door answers it `400 INVALID_SORT` on every load. The `Skills-docs:` line in this body and the changeset now reads `updated here — content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`.
- **S1.** The two stale code notes (`reference-integrity-suite.ts` near line 289, `authoring-rules.ts` near lines 1253–1256) now say the page crossing also answers existence (`page-field-unknown`, `error`) and provenance (`page-field-unprovisioned`, `warning`). Comments only.

**Round 1 verification, head `647a1c1f`.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` now derives 87 families (the docs edit adds 29, the docs-audit and spec doc families among them); all 87 exit 0, `--ran`: 87 derived, 87 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm lint`: exit 0. `@objectstack/lint` rebuilt after the comment edits. The source change since round 0 is comments and one docs page, so the round-0 test, dogfood and reverse-verification readings below still describe the code.
